faqs.question: Why take MET Amplification FISH Test?
faqs.answer: Providing prognostic information and guiding treatment primarily for patients with lung cancer.

faqs.question: Is this test for you?
faqs.answer: Your doctor may suggest to get the test done to provide prognostic information and guiding treatment primarily for patients with lung cancer.

faqs.question: More Info on MET Amplification FISH Test
faqs.answer: MET is a proto-oncogene and its overexpression is associated with disease progression. Recent studies have shown MET amplification to be a major mechanism of acquired resistance to certain anti cancer medicines.
